brief: DTC brand ships 15,000 orders/month through a 3PL at $7.20/parcel. Options: bring last-mile in-house ($550k fleet + micro-warehouse capex, ~$4.10/parcel at volume), stay with the 3PL, or run a hybrid — own fleet in 3 metros, 3PL for the long tail. Goal: cut cost per order without dropping below 95% 2-day delivery. Horizon: 18 months.
